name: Fiend of Forges adds 10% crit chance to Forgefiend's Bulwark's Enrage buff (#1586)
contract: Fiend of Forges 300386 reads 'Forgefiend's Bulwark now also increases your critical strike chance by 10%' (bindmysoul.com/conquest/talents.normalized.json, fetchedAt 2026-07-22T23:10:31.369Z; matches the client's own moa_description). Forgefiend's Bulwark's Enrage buff (801019, applied by the 801065 block/parry/dodge proc) already carries a dormant EFFECT_1 in the installed Spell.dbc: native aura 290 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT), BasePoints -1/DieSides 1 -> base 0. Fiend of Forges' own baked effect is a stray SPELLMOD_EFFECT2 (misc 12) scoped to 801019's own classmask, but SPELLMOD_EFFECT2 only feeds specific native effect-value lookups, not the CalcValue() path that sets an aura's own base amount, so it never raised the crit chance. AscensionXorothContracts.cpp nulls it; aura_ascension_xoroth_lifecycle::Calculate (AscensionXorothAuras.cpp) now sets 801019's EFFECT_1 amount to Amount(300386, 0) = 10 while the caster knows the talent, and to 0 otherwise - the same claimed-inert-slot pattern Speed Demon/Suffuse (#1223) uses. SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT feeds both Player::UpdateAllWeaponDependentCritAuras and UpdateAllSpellCritChances, so melee_crit_chance moves with it.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Force the Enrage buff without Fiend of Forges
SETUP: the Enrage buff is active
BASELINE: Enrage's own crit slot stays at zero without the talent
BASELINE: crit chance is unaffected without the talent
SETUP: Fiend of Forges is learned
Reapply Enrage so its amount recomputes with the talent known
SETUP: Enrage is active with Fiend of Forges known
CONTRACT: Enrage's crit slot rises to 10
CONTRACT: crit chance rises by 10 percentage points while Enrage is active
REGRESSION: crit chance returns to baseline once Enrage expires
